headline: Welcome to your learning journey—everything you need to know to get started
universal_truth: Every journey begins with a single step; today you're taking yours
fun_facts: Learners who complete their first week are 80% more likely to continue
The hardest part of any habit is starting—you've already done that
Your brain is already changing from making this decision to learn
discussion_questions: What are you hoping to gain from daily learning?
What might try to stop you, and how will you overcome it?

hook.script: Welcome! This is your first day as a Curious Kelly learner. I'm genuinely excited you're here. Let me show you around and help you get started on the right foot.

cliff.script: Starting something new is both exciting and overwhelming. What's the most important thing to know right now?
cliff.prompt: What matters most on day one?

options.text: Just show up—the system is designed to guide you; you don't need to figure everything out today; consistency matters more than perfection
options.response: Exactly. Your only job today is to be here. Tomorrow, show up again. The lessons will teach themselves. You just need to keep coming back.
You can explore features as you go. The basics are simple: watch your daily lesson, do the activity if you can. That's it...

fact1.title: Your Daily Rhythm
fact1.script: Each day has a LEARN lesson—exploring ideas about the world—and a GROW activity—building your skills. Watch, reflect, practice. Five to ten minutes daily. That's your rhythm.

fact2.title: Progress Tracking
fact2.script: Your dashboard shows your streak, completed lessons, and progress through the year. Watch the numbers grow as you show up consistently. It's surprisingly motivating.

fact3.title: You're Not Alone
fact3.script: The Commons connects you to other learners. Share insights, ask questions, see what others think. Learning is better together, even when you're learning independently.

wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: You've already done the hardest part—you started. Now just keep going. One day at a time. One lesson at a time.

outro.script: That's your orientation. Head to Day 1 of the calendar to begin your actual journey. I'll see you there—and every day after. Welcome to Curious Kelly.

growTrack.title: First Day Setup - Set Yourself Up for Success
growTrack.activity: Choose your daily learning time. Set a reminder on your phone. Tell one person about your new learning habit. These three actions dramatically increase your chances of success.
